basics.name: Aadharsh Pannirselvam
basics.summary: I am a lifelong technology obsessive with a history of testing and engaging with canary and homebrew software at the frontier; I bricked my parents' iPhone 3G on launch day, and then learned about iOS jailbreaking and tweaking, which exposed me to open source, cryptography, and Bitcoin, putting me onto much of the work I do today as an investor and researcher at Archetype. Somewhere in parallel, I got nerdsniped by chrome://flags and about:config on Chrome Canary and Firefox Nightly respectively, which put me onto Rust via the Servo efforts to rewrite Firefox, but only after I'd bricked my space-limited Mac by clearing what seemed like unnecessary 32-bit support files via a tool called Monolingual.

work.name: Archetype
highlights: Drive technical due diligence on advanced technologies, including parallel execution for distributed systems, eval design, model architectures, and audio processing for voice models, for investments in Turnkey, TACEO, and Hume AI

Built Archie, Archetype's Slack agent, platform, and skills, on top of Paradigm Centaur and Kubernetes by standing up CI/CD, unifying databases, and streamlining context sharing firmwide as part of a mandate expansion
Upstreamed issues, PRs, and RFCs to Centaur as it evolved, including PR #2169 to drop 16 RustCrypto packages
Wrote a 3-part series on privacy-enhancing technologies (TEEs, MPC, FHE, obfuscation) that shaped the firm's applied-cryptography thesis

work.name: Galaxy
highlights: Led diligence on Mysten's Series A by benchmarking Sui's Move-based state concurrency model against Solana's parallelism and consensus protocol, resulting in a liquid buy

projects.name: Maintainer
highlights: Teach formal verification, audio hardware, and web image encoding via inline demos and pop quizzes on LWE pages
Reverse-engineer technical blogs, web platform flags, and Cloudflare features, identifying downstream implications

Co-solved Paradigm's Kryptos-style Vignere ciphers in a 20+ contributor collaborative repo by orchestrating the group's compute and agents with CI/CD and an autoresearch-style harness to identify and test solution ideas

projects.name: Contributor
highlights: Engaging in-person with cryptography auditors, engineering managers, and TPMs on the cultural and technical evolution of engineering, resulting in an early view into a future of lighter CI, heavier code review, and personal forks

Designed a personal software factory, houseguest, for coding agents to fit my contributions to external repos, using learnings from technical conferences, APoSD, and publications and improving merge rate by ~20%
Fixed the WebMCP standard on EmDash 1.2, a WordPress replacement, to make hosted content legible to AI agents
Resolved workerd's zstd dropped dictionaries issue, leading to 21.9% off updates on static pages at ~0.2 ms CPU each
